text: Curtis, I can't help you if you keep things from me.
Have you been having more problems than you've told me about?
Because if you're having, say, delusions or blackouts or hallucinations,
you need to tell me right away.
Are you and Merrick trying to get me to go back to that hellhole of a nut house?
Look, I got news for you. I'd rather die.
I haven't spoken to Dr. Merrick in months.
I am just trying to help you get better.
